Got a 7.5 lift and after a while noticed there was a grove in my drive shaft, they were supposed to put a spacer to prevent this from happening which I’m guessing they didn’t get the part but how are you going to leave the job done like this. Bummer the webpage oversells their abilities. JR’s doesn’t do custom work, only snap on or bolt on. They were not willing to research parts or kits for stuff they are not familiar with. JR’s mostly works for Credit Card Jeepers and F150 guys. 2 stars, for taking my call and being a good listener.

I placed an order online for local shop install
Jrs picked up accepted the install made an appointment
On the day of install “owner” as he called himself was clueless. As I was trying to show him the email he took my phone out of my hand and looked like he was trying to delete the email. I got my phone back and he told me to leave and install the part myself.
He later came out to my vehicle to apologize but when I said I already got someone else he then told me to get off his property.
Never recommend this place unless you like the rudeness and complete lack of customer service and respect

If you want an estimate that's going to be double what anyone else will charge these people are the ones to see. They will go out of there way to show you out the door and smile will doing it. I have no idea why I stop by here sometimes... Maybe to remind myself that there is always a worse place to go. The only joy of this place is being able to play fetch with the black lab they have running around the store. How these people are still in business is beyond me.

Every time I've ever walked into this business if I'm able to even get the attention of the person on the sales floor they are down right insulting... I guess I'm not dressed in clothes that say I spend money. Maybe if I went in wearing a suit and tie they'd act like they care. I'll just go to Bonnie and Clyde auto for my customization needs as they greet you and work with you to make sure you get what you want without making you feel worthless.

Wow and now I'm being belittled by the owner himself, that just goes to show you how much of a lowlife the owner and his business are. Don't worry I won't be back to your pathetic shop when there is so much better out there with reasonable prices that's just as good and better than your workmanship.

This is a factual review left by a real life potential customer.

I had JR's install a Topo Lift kit for my Ford Transit camper van. They did a great job installing the lift kit, but the amount of labor they charged to install was ridiculous.

To install the lift kit they charged $1,800 of labor at a rate of $75 an hour. That equates to 24 hours of labor. For a professional shop to justify that many install hours is out of control.
I called this place and the man said he dont do mechanic work?????? Well wth!

Called, drove in and spoke with an installer who was helpful.  Made arrangements to return that day to leave my car and confirmed with the installer that that was fine.  Arrived 10 minutes after calling to be told by the "management" that the installer was being assigned a priority job outside the store and they could not help me until maybe tomorrow.  No accommodation, no re-tasking of other technicians, no apology, nothing.
Waste of time to deal with people like this unless you have a multi-thousand $ install. And they wanted $125/hr rate.   I looked online and found a shop in Arlington (Mobile Sound Systems) that was friendly, accommodating, and charged only $75/hr install rate.

They can’t keep to their promises and don’t communicate at all. I scheduled a Van Compass install 8 weeks in advance and dropped the van off 8a Monday morning. I was told it would be ready Tuesday. I called on Tuesday afternoon to ask when I should come by and was told that they hadn’t started and that it would take until Thursday. They said they had another van come in on Monday and did it first and that they can only do one at a time. So not only did they schedule over top of me and bump me, they didn’t even proactively communicate the new pickup time. We live in the van, so we incurred three nights lodging plus Lyft fare to and from the shop to get this done. And JR’s didn’t deliver.

Went in yesterday to look for accessories for my Jeep and was ready to spend some money. Not a great experience. Was directed to the back window and the guy there looked up some things on his computer. I can do that on Ebay. Was hoping for some expertise or advice on what brands are better quality, etc. He didn't really seem interested or ask questions. Also in the middle of the showroom was a huge Trump 2020 flag that said No More BullSh*t. I get it -4x4, Murica, trucks, etc. but why would you want to alienate ANY customers over your political beliefs? The guy took my info and said he would call but haven't heard back. I'll be spending my money elsewhere. Just not a good overall experience- maybe it was just a bad day but it wasn't like they were overrun with customers... The people that work there don't seem very happy.

I bought rims here and no one had any idea the size that fit my cars and gave me all same for front and back. Also they were too careless to see the bigger tires goes in back and instead put them in front. I drove like this for 8 months until I went to discount tires and they notified me of the tires and wheels. Very dissatisfying and disappointed.
